title: canthium perakanthus
intro: Canthium perakanthus, commonly known as the Perak canthium or Kadupul, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Canthium perakanthus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, relieve pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
